note: Descriptive feature diagnostics only; image means do not replace patch features for fitting or conditioning. Compare fixed generated images independently.
partial_geometry_note: Fitted row statistics precede projection; source-neighborhood and projected-patch statistics include query smoothing. Dense pair metrics are weighted by routing and retained/support-valid mass. Projected-patch metrics average individual pair conditionals, not the final mixture across pairs. Image query neighborhoods precede the router; raw image weights precede selection/pair pruning. Their effective counts are descriptive, not additive or semantic correctness scores.
routing_note: After image top-k/selection: intentionally excluded + failed + successful pair mass = 1. Only successful routes are renormalized; partial-OT rejection/support confidence apply afterward.
